title: Modeling Kinetics of a Large-Scale Fed-Batch CHO Cell Culture by Markov Chain Monte Carlo Method

model_assumptions.text: Specific growth rate is zero during the cell death phase.
model_assumptions.quote: It was assumed that $\mu = 0$ during the cell death phase.

model_assumptions.text: Glucose and glutamine maintenance terms are zero when d ≤ 6.
model_assumptions.quote: Since $m_{\mathrm{glc}}$ and $m_{\mathrm{gln}}$ are negligible during exponential growth,$^{1,2,11}$ it was assumed $m_{\mathrm{glc}} = 0$ and $m_{\mathrm{gln}} = 0$ when $d \leq 6$.

model_assumptions.text: Ammonia and lactate are considered in the growth-rate equation only above 90% of their thresholds.
model_assumptions.quote: Therefore, the ammonia or lactate was considered in Eq. 7 only when the concentration exceeded 90% of their threshold value, or 4.6 and 52 mM for ammonia and lactate, respectively.

model_assumptions.text: The B1 mass balance is applied only after 144 h.
model_assumptions.quote: The mass balance for titer, [B1], was applied only after 144 h
